title: Best Places to Buy Aluminum Plate Online in 2026: All 9 Compared
summary: Nine aluminum plate suppliers compared on pricing, ship dates, cut tolerance, certification, alloy depth, and minimums. A best-for verdict on each, including the cases where we are the wrong answer.
body_markdown:
### What is the best place to buy aluminum plate online?


For certified plate with instant pricing and a committed ship date, NOX METALS. For broad catalog and no cut fees on small pieces, OnlineMetals.com. For an AS9100 aerospace program, Yarde Metals. For a standard piece tomorrow morning, McMaster-Carr. The right answer depends on whether you need certification, thickness, or speed.


### Which aluminum supplier is cheapest?


For thin, common material in small quantities, Metals Depot and OnlineMetals are usually cheapest. For thick plate and repeat quantities, cut-to-size from a plate supplier is materially cheaper per finished part because you buy closer to net shape. Run the buy-to-fly ratio on your actual part rather than comparing price per pound.


### Which suppliers stock 7050 aluminum plate?


Three of the nine: NOX METALS, OnlineMetals.com, which stocks 7050-T7451 to 7 inches citing AMS 4050, and Yarde Metals. McMaster-Carr, Speedy Metals, Metals Depot, and buymetal.com do not, and Clinton does not feature it.


### Which aluminum supplier gives the fastest delivery?


McMaster-Carr for standard catalog sizes, with same or next day delivery. For cut-to-size plate, NOX METALS is the only one of the nine that commits to a per-line ship date at quote time, and we deliver nights and weekends, which typically saves two to three calendar days on a Friday order.


### Do I need a certified supplier?


Only if your print or purchase order says so. Shop fixtures, hobby work, and most commercial fabrication do not need mill certs, and paying for certified material there is waste. Aerospace, defense, and regulated structural work do, and on those jobs a catalog seller with no published certification policy is the wrong tool.
